title: Establish the first correlated active-task usage baseline
scope: Extend the read-only Phase 4B usage baseline so canonical Work Items and provider-owned Codex task observations can be compared without storing prompts, inventing token values, looking up prices, switching models, or writing to external systems.
acceptance_criteria: A newly registered live Codex task for WI-0014 moves from awaiting-observation to observed when provider-owned detailed usage arrives.
The usage report exposes longitudinal Work Item coverage and correlated token-observation coverage while unsupported values remain explicitly unknown.
No token-savings, cost, model-quality, or routing claim is made before the documented longitudinal qualification gates are satisfied.
The exact candidate revision passes the full automated suite and fresh independent QA.
